// app: Entry point for `cdk synth` and `cdk deploy`. ts-node runs bin/app.ts directly — no compile step needed. --prefer-ts-exts ensures .ts files take priority over .js when both exist.
// watch: Config for `cdk watch` — hot-deploys on file changes during development. Excludes non-source files to avoid unnecessary redeploys.
// context: CDK feature flags and project-level settings. These opt into recommended
behaviors that CDK doesn't enable by default for backward compatibility.

context.// recognizeLayerVersion: Enables automatic detection of Lambda Layer versions to avoid unnecessary updates.
context.// checkSecretUsage: Warns when secrets are used in ways that might expose them (e.g. in CloudFormation outputs).
context.// target-partitions: Restricts resource generation to the standard AWS partition. Set to ['aws', 'aws-cn'] if deploying to China regions.
context.// minimizePolicies: Collapses redundant IAM policy statements into fewer statements. Reduces CloudFormation template size.
context.// validateSnapshotRemovalPolicy: Ensures you explicitly set a removal policy on stateful resources (tables, buckets) instead of relying on the default (RETAIN).
context.// serverAccessLogsUseBucketPolicy: Uses bucket policy (not ACLs) for S3 server access logging. ACLs are deprecated as of April 2023.
context.// bootstrapQualifier: Custom qualifier for the CDK bootstrap stack. Avoids collisions if multiple CDK projects share the same AWS account. Default is 'hnb659fds'.
